profile.name: Darun Mustafa
profile.title: Full-Stack & AI Developer
profile.bio: Backend & AI engineer building production-grade systems in React/TypeScript, Node.js/Fastify/Express, PostgreSQL, MongoDB and Docker — with a consistent focus on auth security, API contract design and real-time data. Built five LLM-integrated projects using Gemini (four live), including a three-provider voice pipeline with Deepgram and ElevenLabs. Experience with multi-provider pipelines, hybrid RAG with quality scoring, Zod-validated output, token-budget enforcement and circuit breakers.

education.note: Also hold a CareerFoundry Full-Stack Web Development Certificate (Jun 2023 – Aug 2024) and a Business Administration Diploma (UHR-evaluated: SeQF Level 5). 3,300+ GitHub contributions since Jul 2023 across live deployed systems.

projects.title: Research Assistant Platform
projects.description: Production-grade RAG + AI agent system. Upload documents, ask questions, stream agent reasoning steps in real time.
highlights: 640+ Jest unit tests with 82% line coverage enforced in CI
Hybrid retrieval: pgvector cosine similarity + BM25 keyword search merged via Reciprocal Rank Fusion
Multi-node agent workflow (classify → retrieve/tool-use → evaluate) with automated quality scoring and retry logic
Artillery load-testing suite covering baseline, spike, and sustained-load scenarios
Real-time streaming of agent reasoning steps
OpenTelemetry instrumentation for end-to-end tracing

projects.title: voice-agent
projects.description: Real-time three-provider voice pipeline: Deepgram streaming speech-to-text, Gemini reasoning, ElevenLabs text-to-speech, coordinated over a persistent WebSocket.
highlights: Real-time voice pipeline integrating three providers
Per-provider circuit breakers with graceful degradation — falls back to text input if speech-to-text fails
Daily token ceiling with pre-flight budget checks per Gemini/ElevenLabs call — 429 once exceeded, alert at 80%
Sentry error tracking and automated accessibility testing (axe-core)

highlights: Hybrid RAG chat grounded in the CV and project docs, with self-maintaining embeddings driven by GitHub webhooks
pnpm + Turborepo monorepo with shared types package
Argon2id password hashing + HttpOnly JWT + CSRF double-submit protection
Structured Gemini chat with Zod-validated JSON output
ATS source aggregation (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Adzuna) with AI-scored matching

projects.title: CleanNation

Argon2id password hashing, JWT auth, Redis-backed rate limiting
Status: in progress

projects.title: Smart Home Automation API
projects.description: Full real-time IoT control system with MQTT device commands, multi-tenant RBAC, and Socket.io state broadcasting.

Server-side Gemini integration for natural-language device commands
Tenant-isolated RBAC at middleware layer — cross-tenant data access is structurally blocked
Live on Render with full Swagger/OpenAPI documentation
